name: Buffer
description: A "social media workspace" for planning and scheduling content across social platforms, with tools for creation, publishing, and community engagement.
best_for: Positioned for creators, small businesses, agencies, nonprofits, higher-education institutions, and developers wanting simplified social media management.
features: Publish: schedule content across 11+ platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, YouTube, X)
Create: content idea organization plus built-in AI Assistant for drafting/repurposing
Community: unified dashboard for responding to comments across channels
Insights: analytics/reporting on performance and posting strategy
Collaborate: team workflows with editing, approvals, and access permissions
Start Page: customizable link-in-bio landing pages

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel, 1 user account.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: Per channel/month ($60/channel billed yearly, saves 2 months). Unlimited scheduled posts, 1 user account.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Per channel/month ($120/channel billed yearly, saves 2 months). Unlimited team members.

cons: Pricing is per connected channel, not a flat team price -- cost scales directly with how many social accounts you connect, on every paid tier.
Free plan is limited to 1 user account -- team collaboration requires upgrading to the Team plan even for just 2 people.

alternatives.name: Hootsuite
alternatives.description: A social media management platform for posting, tracking, and competitive performance across networks.
alternatives.best_for: Social media managers and enterprises managing multiple brand accounts.

alternatives.name: Sprout Social
alternatives.description: A social intelligence platform turning real-time social signals into direction for teams.
alternatives.best_for: Teams and agencies needing social listening and analytics at scale.
